programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Bem-Vindos À Ilha
programme.desc: Longe, numa pequena ilha viviam quatro amigos. Coco, o sábio coqueiro, Bucky o pedregulho curioso, Lily a pequena flor e Blossom, o feliz mamoeiro. Seria de imaginar que não aconteceria muita coisa numa ilha pequena e remota, mas a vida na ilha é cheia de alegria e emoção graças a visitantes ocasionais, como as simpáticas gaivotas que vêm limpar o oceano, a tartaruga que vem pôr ovos ou a abelha que vem à procura de pólen.

programme.title: A Câmara T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Montería celebrada en uno de los santuarios de la modalidad: Los Yébenes. Esta comarca ubicada en la provincia de Ciudad Real alberga multitud de fincas tanto abiertas como cerrada. en esta ocasión jabalíes y venados serán los protagonistas.

programme.title: Chocos Galegos
programme.desc: Varias generaciones de cazadores de una misma familia se reúnen para cazar junto a sus inseparables perros en un coto manchego. Desde el más veterano hasta el más joven, todos disfrutan de una misma pasión.

programme.title: Mazagón: Bonitos Do Sul
programme.desc: La familia Fernandes, con su patriarca a la cabeza lleva un siglo cazando sobre todo la menor. A lo largo de las distintas generaciones el respeto por la naturaleza ha sido su principal seña de identidad.

programme.title: Surfcasting Mundial
programme.desc: Varias generaciones de cazadores de una misma familia se reúnen para cazar junto a sus inseparables perros en un coto manchego. Desde el más veterano hasta el más joven, todos disfrutan de una misma pasión.

programme.title: Canarios En Extremadura
programme.desc: A enguia europeia está à beira do colapso. A proposta de a incluir no LESPRE ameaça pôr fim à pesca e comercialização da enguia juvenil, colocando em confronto cientistas, pescadores, autoridades e a alta gastronomia. Um conflito ecológico, económico e cultural que poderá marcar o ocaso de um dos produtos mais emblemáticos da nossa gastronomia.

programme.title: De Perdices En Familia
programme.desc: Alejandro, Diego e David são três amigos que pescam juntos alguns fins de semana e frequentam o Limia em Ourense. Um rio que tem muitas trutas, mas às vezes está um pouco cheio e isso dificulta a pesca. Também pescam no rio Deva, um rio de montanha, estreito e muito arborizado, com trutas pequenas mas divertidas.

programme.title: É Assim Que Somos: O Ocaso Da Enguia Juvenil
programme.desc: Montería celebrada en uno de los santuarios de la modalidad: Los Yébenes. Esta comarca ubicada en la provincia de Ciudad Real alberga multitud de fincas tanto abiertas como cerrada. en esta ocasión jabalíes y venados serán los protagonistas.

programme.title: Trutas Nos Rios Limia E Deva
programme.desc: O México é conhecido pelos diferentes destinos ao longo da sua geografia para a pesca desportiva, o estado de Sinaloa não é exceção, a cerca de 1 hora de Mazatlan encontra-se a barragem de Picachos, rodeada de paisagens mágicas e com excelente pesca, tem a maior média de capturas por pescador por dia em todo o México.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En Ciudad Real
programme.desc: Ágil, dinámico, directo, el spinning es el estilo de moda en el mundo de la pesca deportiva. Cada vez son más los aficionados que adoptan esta modalidad por su sencillez y resultados. Momento Spinning recoge las experiencias de populares pescadores que han encontrado en el spinning su mejor opción.

programme.title: American Fishing T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Segunda parte de la monteria en La nava donde seguiremos disfrutando de los lances a los grandes cochinos. El plantel con soberbios trofeos pondría el colofón.

De há poucos anos para cá encontram-se envolvidos num projeto para reorganizar o modo de vida da comunidade com um ambicioso guia de pesca e natureza.

O seu objetivo é proteger as suas preciosas vinhas do ataque das abundantes varas de 'porcos-bravos', como são conhecidos os javalis em Portugal.

En estas tierras extremeñas, donde la naturaleza se muestra en su forma salvaje, buscan esos días de caza que en las islas escasean.

John parte para a Costa Ocidental para conhecer o cozinheiro de St. John’s, Nova Terra, que prepara um arroz frito de fazer crescer água na boca com a receita do seu avô, um dos primeiros chineses imigrantes na Nova Terra.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T1 - Ep. 7

Uma viagem gastronómica muito especial.

programme.desc: Em 2018, Marlene Vieira lançou um livro de Doces e neste episódio promete partilhar sugestões de sobremesas que te vão fazer querer comer e chorar por mais! Ah! E sem culpa… que estas não são light mas são na proporção certa!.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira traz duas receitas que nasceram no seu restaurante ZunZum e prometem conquistar muitas casas portuguesas: Bochechas de porco com batata doce e picadinho algarvio e Costeleta de sardinha panada com arroz de tomate.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Chocos guisados com batata doce” proposta pelo Mercado de Olhão e, depois, irá cozinhar “Sericaia”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado do Livramento de Setúbal.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Arroz de tamboril” proposta pelo Mercado de Alvalade em Lisboa e, depois, irá cozinhar “Lombo de porco no forno”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado de São João da Madeira.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: A família Harding está à procura de um cachorrinho a sério que seja mais divertido do que um peluche. Será que os dois irmãos vão conseguir decidir entre o galgo afegão, o golden doodle e o épagneul breton?.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood visita a família McGrayne que procura um cachorrinho. Visitam bulldogs, beagles e Boston terriers, mas as coisas complicam-se, quando o filho mais novo, o Jackson, quer levar os cães todos para casa.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece o Mycal e a Amie, um casal que procura um cão que se enquadre no seu estilo de vida ativo. Enquanto visitam o dogue de Bordéus, o dogue alemão e o boxer, o Mycal mostra o seu lado sensível.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Com a Lua Azul a erguer-se no horizonte, João quer captar a fotografia perfeita. Mas em pleno Alentejo interior, João desvenda ainda os mistérios de 2 grandes navegadores, descobre uma praia entre sobreiros e aprende os segredos do vinho da talha.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Na cidade onde desagua o único rio português que corre de sul para norte, João precisa de vento para descobrir a vela. Mas antes, terá de lançar redes de pesca numa traineira, aprender a falar charroco e provar uma das iguarias desta região.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Conhecer as salinas, perceber como é feita a extração tradicional de sal e experimentar a vida de marnoto fazem parte desta aventura em Aveiro. Mas há mais! Entre o mar e a ria, o surf e a música, há milhares de ovos para partir.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Na Cidade do Cabo, Verónica descobre a diversidade sul-africana: prova koesister em Bo-Kaap e faz piquenique no Signal Hill. Aprende potjiekos em família, visita Khayelitsha e termina com um braai entre vinhas em Stellenbosch.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Em Barcelona, Verónica mergulha na tradição mediterrânea: percorre a cidade com Cristina Jolonch, vive uma calçotada, experimenta o “esmorzar de forquilla” e saboreia bacalhau à llauna. A viagem termina em Vic com o chef Nandu Jubany.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Em Berlim, Verónica celebra o 1º de maio e descobre sabores alemães: aprende a fazer spätzle, explora mercados ecológicos, cozinha pratos sazonais e prova currywurst. A aventura termina com café e a clássica torta Selva Negra.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Scott serve de mentor a dois jovens irmãos ambiciosos que querem aprender a transformar uma antiga casa rústica situada num rancho com bisontes numa casa de férias bem-sucedida.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Scott ajuda uma família ocupada com a sua casa junto à praia que precisa de muitas remodelações.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Fátima Lopes visita a chapeleira Sofia Caldas, criadora de histórias e de chapéus carregados de mensagens únicas. Mais a norte, irá conhecer a fábrica de chapéus onde Luís Pinho preserva a tradição ancestral da chapelaria portuguesa.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Há elementos indispensáveis numa casa que nem sempre queremos ver e a caixa de areia do gato é um deles.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, temos um desafio especial: criar um espaço de estudo confortável, bonito e inspirador para uma criança, sem comprar tudo novo.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Scott e Debra voltam a encontrar-se com antigos clientes para os ajudar a transformar uma garagem nunca usada numa fantástica casa de campo com dois quartos.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Scott serve de mentor a dois jovens irmãos ambiciosos que querem aprender a transformar uma antiga casa rústica situada num rancho com bisontes numa casa de férias bem-sucedida.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-sena aventura deos restaurar e transformar em lares desonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: A Nossa Cozinha T1 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: A nossa cozinheira Maria José, uma alentejana de gema, traz-nos as melhores receitas dos pratos mais tradicionais portugueses, um programa cheio de tradição e simplicidade. Neste episódio aprenda a fazer - Meia desfeita e Pudim de arroz.

programme.title: A Nossa Cozinha T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: A nossa cozinheira Maria José, uma alentejana de gema, traz-nos as melhores receitas dos pratos mais tradicionais portugueses, um programa cheio de tradição e simplicidade. Neste episódio aprenda a fazer - Sopas de tomate e Carne do aguilar com migas de batata.

programme.title: A Nossa Cozinha T1 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: A nossa cozinheira Maria José, uma alentejana de gema, traz-nos as melhores receitas dos pratos mais tradicionais portugueses, um programa cheio de tradição e simplicidade. Neste episódio aprenda a fazer - Sopa de feijao e Bifinhos de Peru.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em Big Food Bucket List, o anfitrião e comediante John os espectadores em aventuras gastronómicas únicas pela América do Norte, enquanto verifica os pratos mais dignos de baba e as paragens culinárias obrigatórias ao longo do caminho.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Em Big Food Bucket List, o anfitrião e comediante John os espectadores em aventuras gastronómicas únicas pela América do Norte, enquanto verifica os pratos mais dignos de baba e as paragens culinárias obrigatórias ao longo do caminho.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Em Big Food Bucket List, o anfitrião e comediante John os espectadores em aventuras gastronómicas únicas pela América do Norte, enquanto verifica os pratos mais dignos de baba e as paragens culinárias obrigatórias ao longo do caminho.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Esta semana viajamos até Leiria. E vamos inspirar-nos em terras à beira-mar. A primeira proposta tem como inspiração Peniche e é uma tiborna de sardinha. No segundo prato viajamos até Vieira de Leiria onde o arroz de marisco é rei.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: O mapa de Portugal hoje leva-nos até ao distrito de Beja onde a gastronomia alentejana é rainha. Numa terra em que com pouco se faz muito, a chef Marlene Vieira apresenta-nos duas propostas. A primeira é uma costeleta com ameijoas e miga enrolada. A segunda proposta é Açorda de Bacalhau com grão.

programme.title: The Point With Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xin's very own unique perspective.

programme.title: Vingança
programme.desc: Cain Burgess é repetida e violentamente agredido na prisão, mas quando começa a responder na mesma moeda a sua pena vai sendo prolongada. Quando ele descobre o responsável pelos seus tormentos, acaba por evadir-se e vai em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Hell Or High Water - Custe O Que Custar!
programme.desc: Um pai divorciado e seu irmão mais velho, um ex-condenado, recorrem a um plano desesperado de assalto a bancos para salvar a fazenda da sua família no Oeste do Texas.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: Todos Sabem
programme.desc: Laura viaja com os filhos de Buenos Aires até à sua aldeia-natal perto de Madrid para assistir ao casamento da irmã, mas uma série de acontecimentos desencadeia uma crise familiar que vai expor segredos do passado.

programme.title: Snow - Uma Viagem Heróica
programme.desc: Para chegar à malévola Rainha da Neve, Kiara, uma destemida órfã, terá que atravessar um deserto gelado e enfrentar os mais variados vilões na sua luta para encontrar Kai, o irmão que julgava perdido, com a ajuda da sua doninha de estimação, do troll Orm e de uma dupla de Pirata Mãe e Pirata Filha.

programme.title: Snow - O Espelho Da Rainha
programme.desc: Após ajudar a derrotar a Rainha da Neve, Orm torna-se um verdadeiro herói do povo. Só que para ele isso não é suficiente e começa a exagerar os seus feitos, com consequências inesperadas, numa nova aventura que prova que os amigos, a felicidade e o verdadeiro amor vencem qualquer mentira!

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: Balbúrdia No Oeste
programme.desc: Com o objetivo de levar à ruína uma cidade do Oeste para roubar as terras aos locais, um político corrupto nomeia um xerife negro, que ele acha que irá provocar o caos entre os locais, mas que afinal se tornará o maior defensor da população.

programme.title: Na Lista Do Assassino
programme.desc: O polícia “Dirty” Harry Callahan tem como missão travar um jogo secreto e doentio cujo objetivo é assassinar celebridades e em que um dos alvos é ele próprio.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan ´Jack´ O´Neil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Vingança
programme.desc: O campeão de kickboxing Eric Sloane aceita participar numa luta ilegal de Muay Thai na Tailândia mas morre às mãos do implacável Tong Po. Kurt, o seu irmão mais novo, jura vingá-lo e é treinado por Durand para conseguir sobreviver à batalha final contra o mortífero lutador.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth casa com um brilhante cientista e muda-se para a luxuosa casa dele, onde há apenas um quarto em que é impedida de entrar. Quando ela decide investigar a razão, percebe que o marido pode não ser quem ela pensa.

programme.title: Mark Felt - O Homem Que Derrubou A Casa Branca
programme.desc: Esta é a história do anónimo mais famoso da história americana: Mark Felt, o vice-presidente do FBI que foi o “Garganta Funda”, o denunciante secreto que ajudou os jornalistas Bob Woodward e Carl Bernstein a revelarem o escândalo Watergate em 1972.

programme.title: Bikes
programme.desc: Spokesville é a terra das bicicletas. Speedy é um velocípede de montanha e está pronto para ser o líder quando o motor a gasolina chega para incomodar toda a cidade. Agora, terá de fazer de tudo para enfrentar a nova realidade e manter a cidade limpa.

programme.title: Snow - A Pedra Dos Desejos
programme.desc: O raro dom de estar constantemente a arranjar sarilhos é um traço que une estes nossos amigos! Que mais poderíamos esperar de gémeos criados entre trolls? Mas Kiara e Kai estão agora mais crescidos e o nível de confusão aumenta – desta vez, eles vão mesmo precisar da ajuda de todos.

programme.title: Snow - Os Domínios Do Espelho
programme.desc: Certo dia o Rei Harald, que odeia magia, decide isolar todos os Mágicos nos Domínios do Espelho. Desta forma, a última esperança para o Universo da Magia, é Kiara. Ela terá de descobrir os seus verdadeiros poderes e salvar a sua família, todos os mágicos e a própria magia!

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: Após um espetáculo de ilusionismo em Londres, Sondra, uma estudante norte-americana de jornalismo, apercebe-se que consegue ouvir a voz de um reporter já falecido, que a vai conduzir na investigação da identidade de um assassino, que poderá ser o aristocrata por quem ela se apaixonou.

programme.title: Asiaticos Doidos E Ricos
programme.desc: Rachel é uma professora sino-americana que viaja até Singapura com o namorado Nick e fica chocada ao perceber que a família dele é uma das mais ricas e influentes do país.

programme.title: Big Game Instinto Caçador
programme.desc: Nas florestas da Finlândia, um jovem de 13 anos descobre uma cápsula de salvação do Air Force One. O homem ferido à sua frente é o Presidente dos EUA, e há um grupo de terroristas a caminho para tentar raptá-lo. Agora vão ter de agir em equipa para sobreviver à noite mais perigosa das suas vidas.

programme.title: Assalto Ao Shopping
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon é um ex-militar que só consegue arranjar emprego como segurança de supermercado. Logo na primeira noite, tem de proteger uma menina que é atacada por mercenários profissionais para a impedirem de testemunhar contra eles.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Retaliação
programme.desc: Um ano após os acontecimentos de “Kickboxer - A Vingança”, Kurt Sloan jura nunca voltar à Tailândia. Mas acaba por ser forçado a regressar ao ser dopado e atirado para uma prisão. Para recuperar a liberdade, terá de enfrentar Mongkut, um verdadeiro gigante de 200kg e mais de dois metros de altura.

programme.title: O Nome do Medo
programme.desc: Quando três amigos da faculdade encontram as origens horríveis do Bye Bye Man, descobrem que há apenas uma maneira de evitar a sua maldição: não pensar nele, não dizer o seu nome. Mas quando ele entra nos nossos pensamentos, assume o controle. Existirá alguma maneira de sobreviver ao seu poder?

programme.title: Puccini - La Bohème
programme.desc: Gustavo Dudamel conducts the Paris Opera Orchestra and Choir in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s La Bohème. Recorded at the Opéra National de Paris in 2017 and directed by Claus Guth. Among the soloists are Nicole Car, Aida Garifullina Atalla Ayan and Artur Rucinski. La Bohème premiered in 1896 at the Teatro Regio in Italy. The opera's libretto focuses on the relationship between Rodolfo and Mimì.

programme.title: A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 5, Op. 64
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sounds like Christmas
programme.desc: Set in the magnificent Cistercian Monastery Schulpforte near Naumburg, Germany, Sounds like Christmas combines festive music with the spontaneity and freshness of jazz. This Christmas program is the musical encounter between soprano Angelika Kirchschlager and jazz trumpeter Tomasz Stanko.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Karl Jenkins - The Armed Man: A Mass for Peace
programme.desc: For this truly unique, historic occasion, Welsh composer Sir Karl Jenkins conducts The World Orchestra for Peace and around 2,000 singers from nearly 30 countries to Sing for Peace at the Berlin's Mercedes Benz Arena on November 2, 2018. Soloists are vocalists Leah-Marian Jones, Yumeji Matsufuji, Pauline Rathmann, Amir Aziz, violinist Krzysztof Wisniewski and cellist Valentino Worlitzsch.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra
programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. The slowly starting opening movement of the symphony depicts the awakening of nature in spring.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Josquin -The Imitation Game
programme.desc: Is citation plagiarism? Not in the music of the Middle Ages and Renaissance. Composers cut, pasted, and conjured with existing melodies and created new works from historical material. The singer-researchers of Cappella Pratensis closely examine Josquin’s ingenious tricks of the trade and place him next to examples and followers like Busnois, Ockeghem, and Willaert.

programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie And Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolinska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky’s semi-autobiographical symphony.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Considered by Bruckner as the artistic climax of his career, the Symphony No. 8 followed in the wake of the triumphs celebrated by his 7th Symphony and Te Deum. Yet the conductor put aside the original version of the work – which Franz Welser-Möst conducts here – when his friend the conductor Hermann Levi rejected it. The original version was first performed in 1954 and first published in 1972.

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace III
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), III’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and sho, a Japanese free-reed mouth organ, played here by Naomi Sato. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music. This performance was recorded at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: The Orchestra Mozart, founded in 2004, is supposed to give young, talented musicians a possibility to play in a world-class orchestra being conducted by one of the outstanding conductors of our time. Claudio Abbado, the artistic director, is responsible for its profile, inviting musicians and chamber ensembles of international reputation.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2003 - A Gershwin Night
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin is one of the most attractive outdoor amphitheatres in Europe and home to the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. With a 20, 000-seat capacity, these events are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world. In 2003, Seiji Ozawa and the Berliner Philharmoniker perform works by George Gershwin with the jazz pianist Marcus Roberts and his Trio as special guests.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Liszt - Totentanz, S. 525
programme.desc: Russian pianist Dina Ivanova performs Franz Liszt’s Totentanz, S. 525, during the Solo finals of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held at TivoliVredenburg in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Totentanz (Dance of Death) is one of Liszt’s many works that reflect the Romantic composer’s fascination with death. The piece is a series of variations on the macabre Gregorian Dies irae theme.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 21
programme.desc: From the Rammenau Castle, the Gewandhaus-Quartett presents Mozart's String Quartet No. 21 in D major, K. 575. Nicknamed The Violet, this piece was composed in 1789 and is the first of the Prussian Quartets, a series of plays written for Friedrich Wilhelm II, King of Prussia and amateur cellist, in a style similar to Joseph Haydn's quartets.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Debussy, Chopin and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Josquin in Spain - Missa Hercules Dux Ferrariæ
programme.desc: Spanish and Flemish musical chapels characterized the music practice at the courts of Charles V and Philip II. But how would Josquin sound in the Spanish tradition, with singers doubled by wind instruments? And how would Josquin sound alongside music by his admirer Guerrero?

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Chopin, Brahms and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1996: Saint Petersburg
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Bizet - Symphony in C
programme.desc: Enjoy a sparkling performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous Piano Concerto No. 1, by the incredible piano virtuoso Russian Daniil Trifonov, with Kent Nagano conducting the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, to prove once more how majestic and incredible classical music can be when it’s done right! The concert opens with the famous Air from Bach's Orchestral Suite No. 3.

programme.desc: As emoções do futebol jogam se todos os dias. Todas as novidades dos grandes do futebol a caminho de mais uma jornada de golos, polémicas, alegrias e tristezas para Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.desc: Noite das Estrelas é um late show como nunca se fez no País apresentado por Maya que analisam os temas palpitantes do mundo social e cor-de-rosa, com a ajuda de um painel de luxo que conta com Teresa Guilherme, Daniel Nascimento, Adriano Silva Martins, Gisela Serrano e Duarte Siopa.

Brown, que por sua vez é inspirado numa história real, Benedetta traça o retrato de uma freira católica que tem visões eróticas e religiosas perturbadoras, a irmã Benedetta Carlini (Virginie Efira).

programme.desc: Uma história de amor envolvendo um homem, um adolescente e uma criança. Ela é Estrellita uma linda e sensual mulher, capaz de exercer um fascínio no sexo oposto e em diferentes faixas etárias. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 87
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 49
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 83
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: WRaP!
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. This episode MotorMusic invites the jazz trio ‘WRaP!

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sienna Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Buana, Buana, King Kong
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wouter Hamel Live in Paradiso
programme.desc: What Jamie Cullum is to England, Wouter Hamel is to the Netherlands: a performer who knows the difference between jazz and pop! Hamel is backed by big band Sven Happel (double bass), Jasper van Hulten (drums), Gijs Anders van Straalen (percussion), Rory Ronde (guitar), Benjamin Herman (saxophone), and a string ensemble. Hamel plays the guitar, piano, sings, and writes many of his own songs.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Musical Genocide
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Stift Festival: Suite del Ángel
programme.desc: Late August is traditionally the time for the annual Stift International Music Festival. Weerselo’s Stift Church and Oldenzaal’s ‘Hofkerk’ serve as venues for wonderful concerts of various young musicians from all over the world. The theme of the 2014 Stift Festival was “Divine and Demonic Passion”. Young musicians performed divine and demonic chamber music by composers such as Astor Piazzolla.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Myles Sanko
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: Music Machine: Hammond And Steel
programme.desc: Drummer, percussionist, and bandleader Lucas van Merwijk stands for ardent, exotic swing. He has been at the forefront of the European jazz, Latin, and percussion scenes for more than 25 years. He has been playing Cuban music for many years, usually in large ensembles such as ‘Nueva Manteca’ and his 20-piece ‘Cubop City Big Band’.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra And Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Needless to Say
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Enjoy the musical wealth of the All Star Band in this episode of Morgenland Festival.

programme.title: Bad Ass And Blind
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Edina Mokus - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Berlin
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Long Tall Dex: Dexter Gordon Live in '63 And '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64 features three concerts filmed in 1963 and 1964 in Holland, Switzerland and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Filmed while Dexter was living in Europe, these shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano) and jazz classics ‘Blues Walk’, ‘A Night In Tunisia’, ‘Body And Soul’ and others.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: Richard Bona - Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz à Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the wonderful Richard Bona. He conquered the world with his bass and voice a long time ago.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Artvark Saxophone Quartet And Ntjam Rosie: Homelands
programme.desc: Homelands is a collaboration between Artvark Saxophone Quartet and Cameroonian-Dutch singer Ntjam Rosie. The music is inspired by both traditional and modern music from Ntjam’s home country Cameroon, (Manu Dibango and Richard Bona) as well as by an Afro-European blend of soul, jazz, gospel and world music.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with The NPG and Questlove
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Kinda Dukish And Rockin' in Rhythm
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Here's that rainy day
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Song for my father
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Paradox Live: Vein ft. Greg Osby
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Christine Kamau
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto’s second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: B.B. King Orchestra - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1979, legendary American blues guitarist B.B. King gave an unforgettable performance for the audience in The Hague.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: Wee Dot
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Ellington Medley
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Hackensack
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Sluijs And Vermeulen
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs and pianist Erik Vermeulen both had a classical training.

programme.title: Identities. The Recording
programme.desc: ‘Identities: The Recording’ is a concert film about the recording of composer, arranger, saxophonist and band leader Karlis Vanags’s album 'Identities' with the Latvian Radio Big Band. The film shows all the album tracks as well as behind-the-scenes footage. 'Identities', which was recorded directly to analog tape without editing or overdubbing, won the Latvian Music Award for Best Latvian Jazz Album in 2020.
